description: Implementation of the EmailService interface, providing methods to send HTML emails, retrieve email configurations, and save email configurations within the system. The class interacts with other services and modules to perform email operations, parse JSON configurations, and handle exceptions.

classes.name: EmailServiceImpl
classes.description: This class implements the EmailService interface, providing email sending and configuration management functionalities using Spring's @Service and @Autowired for dependency injection.

methods.name: sendHtmlEmail
methods.description: Sends an HTML email to a specified MerchantStore using the provided Email object after configuring the email sender.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the email configuration for a specific MerchantStore from the merchant configuration service, returning an EmailConfig object.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Serializes and saves the EmailConfig object into the merchant configuration system for a specific MerchantStore.
